network.noneDescription: Babu wani abu da ake iya kaiwa sai samfurin API kanta. Shigar da fakitin, git clones da buƙatun yanar gizo duk za su gaza, kamar yadda duk abin da kayan aikin da aka kunna za su isa in ba haka ba - akwatin yashi ba shi da hanyar fita sai adireshin da aka samar da samfurin sa.
network.internetDescription: Ana iya samun intanet na jama'a. Na'ura mai masaukin baki, hanyar sadarwar gida, adiresoshin mahaɗin-gida da wuraren ƙarshen metadata na gajimare an toshe su ta hanyar ka'idojin kwaya na kwantena.
network.allowlistedDescription: Abin da ka lissafa kawai yana iya isa. Sunan mai masaukin da kuka jera yana wucewa ta hanyar wakilin Deepsand; adireshin da ka jera ana isa kai tsaye, don haka bayanan bayanai ko duk wani wanda ba-HTTP abokin ciniki yana aiki. Shigar da ba ta da tashar jiragen ruwa tana rufe kowace tashar jiragen ruwa, kuma tashar da ka lissafo ana buga shi akan madaidaicin mashin ɗin don ku iya isa uwar garken akwatin yashi yana gudana a wurin. Har ila yau an ƙi sunan mai masaukin da ke warwarewa zuwa sararin adireshin gida ko na sirri - jera adireshin kansa don isa gare shi da gangan.
network.fullDescription: Babu ƙuntatawa kwata-kwata, gami da sabis na cibiyar sadarwa na wannan injin. Warewar tsarin fayil ba shi da tasiri, amma ya fi son yanayin kunkuntar.
network.label: Samun hanyar sadarwa
docker.restartTitle: Sake kunna injin Docker - gami da tsarin WSL da yake gudana a ciki - kuma jira har sai akwati na iya sake farawa.
docker.restartCompact: Yana ƙare kowane akwati akan wannan na'ura, sannan ta sake farawa Docker Desktop da WSL tsari.
docker.restartDetail: Wannan yana ƙare kowane kwantena akan wannan injin, gami da akwatunan sandbox na sauran ayyukan. Yana sake farawa Docker Desktop sannan kuma aikin WSL injinsa yana shiga, inda Docker ke amfani da ɗaya.

perm.offDetail: Babu wani abu da wannan aikin ke nema da zai isa gare ku, kuma an gaya wa akwatin yashi kar ku tambaya maimakon a bar shi yana jira. Duk abin da yake buƙata fiye da filin aiki, kundayen adireshi da aka raba da jerin izinin hanyar sadarwa za su gaza kawai. Kunna wannan baya don a sake tambaya.
perm.onDetail: Akwatin yashi na iya neman kundin adireshi, wurin sadarwa ko kayan aikin da ba a shigar da shi ba, kuma za ku yanke kowane ɗaya. Kowane buƙatu an rubuta ta akwatin yashi kuma ba a inganta shi ba, don haka karanta abin da yake nema kafin bayarwa. Kashe wannan idan buƙatun sun zama hayaniya - saitin kowane aiki ne, kuma maganganun buƙatun kuma na iya kashe shi.

request.denyHint: Na ƙarshe. Ana gaya wa DeepCode kada ya sake tambayar wannan.
request.notNowHint: An ƙi a wannan lokacin. DeepCode na iya sake tambaya daga baya.
request.deferredBody: An gaya wa DeepCode cewa wannan ba amsa ta ƙarshe ba ce, don haka yana iya sake tambaya daga baya.
request.secretValuePlaceholder: Manna ƙimar da za a ajiye
request.secretHint: Ana adana ta da ɓoyewa a wannan na'urar kuma ana ba da ita ga sandbox a matsayin maɓallin muhalli. Ba a taɓa rubuta ta cikin aikin ba.
request.secretRequired: Ana buƙatar suna da ƙima duka kafin a ba da wannan.
request.secretSavedBody: An ajiye {name} don wannan aikin. Sake kunna sandbox don ba da shi.
request.notAppliedBody: Deepsand ya ƙi yin hakan kuma ya gaya wa DeepCode dalilin. Ba a ba da komai ba; dalilin yana cikin tarihin Ayyuka na wannan aikin.
request.frozen: Babu wani abu da ke gudana a cikin akwatin yashi yayin da wannan ke buɗe, don haka wakili ba zai iya yin aiki ba kafin shawarar ku. Idan ka ɗauki fiye da minti ɗaya, kiran da ake jira yana ƙarewa a cikin lokacin ƙarewa - yana tattara shawararka daga baya maimakon yin zato.
request.purpose: Abin da ya ce yana buƙatar shi:
request.pathRecheck: Deepsand ya sake duba wannan hanyar da kanta. Hanyar da ta ƙi ba za a iya ba da ita ba ko da kun ƙyale ta.
request.networkHint: Izinin yana ƙara waɗannan zuwa jerin izinin wannan aikin kawai. Har ila yau ana ci gaba da yin ƙin shiga cikin jerin ƙasashen duniya, don haka ba za a iya buɗe rundunar da aka dakatar da app-fadi a nan ba.
request.toolHint: Ana toya kayan aiki a cikin hoton aikin, don haka ba za a iya amfani da shi ba har sai an sake gina hoton kuma an sake kunna akwatin yashi. An gaya wa DeepCode wannan, don haka ba zai yi ƙoƙarin shigar da kansa ba.
request.readOnlyDetail: Yana iya karanta fayilolin amma ba zai iya canza ko share wani abu ba.
request.readWriteDetail: Yana iya ƙirƙira, gyarawa da share fayiloli a cikin wannan kundin adireshi.
request.replyPlaceholder: Babban fayil ɗin jigo kawai, don Allah
request.judgment: Deepsand ba zai iya tabbatar da wakilin yana gaskiya ba, da fatan za a yi amfani da mafi kyawun hukuncinku.
request.pathAllowed: An halatta Zai bayyana a cikin akwatin yashi azaman / kyauta / <name>.
request.pathCannotBeShared: Ba za a iya raba wannan hanyar ba.
request.sharedTitle: Rabawa, kuma akwatin yashi yana sake farawa
request.sharedBody: {name} yanzu ana iya gani ga DeepCode.
request.deniedBody: DeepCode aka gaya wa yanke shawara ta ƙare.
request.requestsOffTitle: DeepCode ba zai sake tambaya ba
request.requestsOffBody: {name} ba zai iya neman izini ba har sai kun kunna shi, cikin Izini.
newProject.subtitle: Aiki kundin tsarin aiki ne tare da izini DeepCode ke da shi a ciki.
newProject.cloneHint: Rufe wurin ajiya kuma yi amfani da clone azaman aikin.
newProject.name: Suna
newProject.pathUsable: Mai amfani Yana zama / sarari aiki a cikin akwatin yashi.
newProject.pathUnusable: Ba za a iya amfani da wannan jagorar ba.
newProject.sandboxSees: Akwatin yashi yana ganin wannan kundin adireshi a/wurin aiki. Ba ya ganin komai har sai kun raba wani abu - ba babban fayil ɗin gidanku ba, ba sauran ayyukanku ba, kuma ba kwatangwalo-lokacin aiki ba.
newProject.createdBody: Guda shi lokacin da kuka shirya.
newProject.browseCloneTitle: Zaɓi kundin adireshi don haɗawa cikin
newProject.cloneHintLong: An kulle ma'ajiyar cikin sabon babban fayil a cikin wannan kundin adireshi. Wannan babban fayil ɗin cloned - ba kundin adireshi da kuka zaɓa ba - ya zama jagorar aiki na aikin.
newProject.namePlaceholder: rashin kuskure ga sunan babban fayil ɗin ma'ajiyar
newProject.credentialsTried: An fara gwada takaddun shaida akan wannan injin - git's da aka adana bayanan shaidar da maɓallan SSH - kuma ma'ajiyar ta ƙi su.
newProject.enterCredentials: Shigar da sunan mai amfani da alamar shiga ta sirri don wannan mai masaukin baki. Ana amfani da su don wannan clone guda ɗaya kuma ba a sami ceto ba.
newProject.importedBody: Babban fayil ɗin cloned shine kundin aiki na aikin.
projectSettings.title: {name} saituna
projectSettings.deepcodePrompts: Izinin nasa DeepCode ya sa a cikin akwatin yashi
projectSettings.modeHint: Kwantena shine ainihin iyaka. Yanayi mai tsauri yana kuma sa DeepCode gaggawa don hanyar sadarwa, MCP da shiga-wurin aiki, tare da faɗakarwa suna bayyana a cikin tasha.
projectSettings.instructions: Umarni ga wakili (mai amfani da gaggawa)
projectSettings.customTitle: Wannan aikin nasa faɗakarwa, wanda aka buga a ƙasa.
projectSettings.offTitle: Kada a aika umarnin tsaye a cikin wannan aikin.
projectSettings.noGlobal: Ba a saita faɗakarwa mai faɗin app, don haka ba a aika komai. Rubuta ɗaya a cikin Saituna kuma yana aiki anan kuma a cikin kowane aikin da ke kan Duniya.
projectSettings.customPlaceholder: Misali: wannan ma'adana TypeScript ne kawai, kuma babu abin da ya ƙare har sai npm gwajin ya wuce.
projectSettings.promptHint: Ana ba da samfurin wannan kafin kowa ya rubuta wani abu, a kowane zaman wannan aikin. Ba zai iya faɗaɗa abin da akwatin yashi ya kai ba - umarni da ke ɗaukar ƙarin samun dama shine dalilin neman sa, ba izini ba - kuma ya isa ko aikin ku yana da AGENTS.md nasa ko a'a.
projectSettings.inheritHint: Yana karanta {path} a kowane farawa. Model: {model}, maɓalli {key}.
projectSettings.apiKeyPlaceholder: API key (bar komai don kiyaye na yanzu)
projectSettings.wipeTitle: Wannan yana goge tarihin tattaunawar nan na DeepCode har abada da kuma bayanan zaman.
projectSettings.wipeDetail: DeepCode zaman, tarihin tattaunawa, haɗe-haɗe da ƙwarewar da aka adana a cikin akwatin yashi za a cire. An dakatar da akwatin yashi da farko. Ba a taɓa babban fayil ɗin aikin {path}; farawa na gaba yana sake ƙirƙirar saitunan DeepCode's da takaddun shaida daga wannan injin.
projectSettings.wipeHint: Yana share tarihin tattaunawa, zaman, haɗe-haɗe da ƙwarewar akwatin sandbox. Ba a taɓa babban fayil ɗin aikin ku akan faifai ba. An dakatar da akwatin yashi da farko; An sake shigar da saitunan DeepCode a farawa na gaba.
projectSettings.savedBody: Suna amfani da na gaba lokacin da akwatin yashi ya fara.
projectSettings.wipedBody: An dakatar da akwatin yashi kuma an cire tarihin hirarsa. {path} ba a taɓa shi ba.
settings.title: Saituna
settings.entryIgnored: {count} shigarwar ba a kula da shi ba
settings.entriesIgnored: {count} shigarwar an yi watsi da su
settings.notBuiltYet: ba a gina shi ba tukuna
settings.userPromptPlaceholder: Misali: bayyana dalili kafin canji, kuma kada ku aikata wani abu ba tare da tambaya ba.
settings.userPromptHint: Ana ba da umarnin tsaye samfurin kafin kowa ya rubuta wani abu, a cikin kowane aikin da bai saita nasa ba. Kowane aikin yana zaɓar tsakanin wannan, faɗakarwarsa, kuma babu ɗaya, a cikin saitunan sa. Ajiye yayin da kake bugawa; akwatin yashi wanda ya riga ya gudana yana kiyaye saurin da aka fara da shi.
settings.networkHint: Yanayin kowane aikin da kuka ƙirƙira daga yanzu yana farawa a ciki. An ba da izini shine tsoho kuma yana nufin ƙin ƙi: ƙirar ƙarshen ƙira, rajistar fakiti a cikin jerin duniya, da duk abin da kayan aikin aikin ke buƙata. Ayyukan da suka wanzu suna kiyaye yanayin da suke da su.
settings.fullWarning: Cikakkiyar ficewa tana cire shingen hanyar sadarwa na gida da kuma jerin izini. Zaɓi wannan kawai idan akwatin yashi da gaske yana buƙatar isa ga injina akan hanyar sadarwar ku.
settings.defaultCredentialsHint: Ana amfani dashi lokacin da tsarin mai watsa shiri da aikin duka basu faɗi komai ba. Maɓallin API ɗin da ke ƙasa ana adana shi a maɓallan tsarin aikin ku, ba a cikin fayil ɗin jihar Deepsand ba.
settings.egressAllowlist: Jerin izinin Egress (mai masaukin baki ɗaya kowane layi)
settings.egressHint: Yanayin hanyar sadarwar da aka ba da izini kawai ke amfani dashi. An yi watsi da bargo *: yi amfani da *.example.com don haɗa ƙananan yanki. Tashar jiragen ruwa 80 da 443 kawai.
settings.autoRestart: Sake kunna akwatin yashi ta atomatik lokacin da aka ba da izini
settings.warnOutside: Faɗakar kafin jefa fayiloli daga wajen aikin
settings.warnOutsideHint: Kashe yana nufin kowane fayil da aka jefa ana kwafa shi ba tare da tambaya ba. Faɗakarwar tana nan saboda fayil daga ko'ina a na'urarka babbar shawara ce fiye da wanda aikin yake gani.
settings.readOnlyRoot: Tsarin fayil ɗin ganga mai karantawa kawai
settings.noNewPrivileges: Toshe haɓaka gata a cikin akwati
settings.netfilterRequired: Ƙi farawa idan ba za a iya aiwatar da manufofin hanyar sadarwa ba
settings.hardenedSeccomp: Yi amfani da Deepsand's hardened seccomp profile
settings.hardeningHint: Docker Desktop yana gudanar da daemon a cikin VM, don haka ba za a iya amfani da bayanan taurare da AppArmor a wurin ba. Deepsand yana faɗin haka a cikin samfotin shirin maimakon yin riya.
settings.closeToTray: Maɓallin rufewa yana ɓoye Deepsand a cikin tire maimakon tsayawa
settings.closeHint: A kashe, rufewa yana yin abin da ya kasance koyaushe: akwatin yashi yana tsayawa kuma Deepsand ya daina. Kunna, taga yana ɓacewa kuma komai yana ci gaba da gudana - gunkin tire ya sake buɗe shi, kuma Tsaida shi yana dakatar da akwatunan yashi.
settings.checkToolUpdates: Bincika kayan aikin da aka adana don sababbin nau'ikan a farawa, da kowane awa shida
settings.allToolsCurrent: Kowane kayan aiki da aka adana yana halin yanzu.
settings.installWarning: Ana sake kunnawa Deepsand, wanda ke tsayawa {target}. Duk abin da wakili bai rubuta zuwa faifai ba ya ɓace, kuma dole ne a sake farawa zaman.
settings.toolCheckHint: Binciken kayan aikin yana tambaya npm da crates.io abin da suke bayarwa don nau'ikan cache ɗin ku, kuma suna ɓarna cache ɗin lokacin da wani abu ya motsa, don haka ginin na gaba ya sake shigar da shi. Ba ya taɓa gina wani abu da kansa, kuma kashe shi yana barin maɓallin "Duba yanzu" yana aiki. An sanya hannu kan sabuntawa, kuma sa hannu shine abin da Deepsand ke dubawa kafin sakawa - ba zazzagewa ba. Za a ƙi sakin da ba a sanya hannu da maɓallin wannan aikin ba.
settings.couldNotCheckTools: An kasa bincika kayan aikin da aka adana
settings.toolsMoved: Kayan aikin da aka adana sun ci gaba
settings.toolsCurrent: Kayan aikin da aka adana na yanzu
settings.nothingNewer: Babu wani abu a cikin cache da aka buga sabon sigar.
settings.watchActivity: Duba ci gaba a cikin Aiki shafin.
settings.startAtSignIn: Fara Deepsand lokacin da na shiga.
settings.startupBackgroundHint: A bango yana farawa ba tare da taga ba kwata-kwata - gunkin tire yana buɗe shi, kuma yana gudana don akwatunan yashi na iya zama.
settings.startupUnreadable: Ba za a iya karanta yanayin farawa akan wannan tsarin ba, don haka ba za a iya canza shi daga nan ba.
settings.startupHint: Akwatunan Sand har yanzu suna farawa ne kawai lokacin da kuke gudanar da su; aikin da aka tsara zai gudanar da kansa bai shafe shi ba.
settings.remoteAccessHint: Ku bauta wa wannan GUI akan HTTP don wata na'ura ta iya isa gare ta. Kashe ta tsohuwa, kuma saitunan da ke ƙasa suna bayyana kawai lokacin da yake kunne.
settings.remotePersist: Ci gaba da sabobin suna gudana a cikin sake kunnawa
settings.remotePersistHint: A hagu, tashar tashar jiragen ruwa tana rufe lokacin da Deepsand ya fita. Wannan shine mafi aminci tsoho: taga da aka buɗe na rana ɗaya bai kamata a buɗe wata mai zuwa ba.
settings.lockoutAria: Ƙoƙarin da bai yi nasara ba kafin kullewa
settings.lockoutHint: Adireshin da aka kulle yana samun "sake gwadawa jim kaɗan" na mintuna biyar; daidaitaccen alama yana share ƙidayar. Sifili yana kashe iyaka, wanda ke da ma'ana akan uwar garken loopback-kawai inda alamar ta zama tsari.
settings.plainHttpWarning: Filayen HTTP, don haka alamar samun damar ketare hanyar sadarwa a rubutu mai haske. Daure zuwa 127.0.0.1 kuma sanya wakili na baya a gaba don TLS da ingantaccen tabbaci; shi ya sa kowane uwar garken ya saba wa loopback.
settings.listenersStopped: An dakatar da kowane mai sauraro.
settings.tokenCopiedBody: Bi da shi kamar kalmar sirri.
settings.copyManually: Zaɓi alamar kuma kwafi da hannu.
settings.reachableNetwork: Ana iya isawa daga hanyar sadarwa
settings.clientMay: Abin da wannan abokin ciniki zai iya yi
settings.capControl: Gudu kuma dakatar da akwatunan yashi, rubuta cikin tasha
settings.capGrant: Ba da izini: buƙatun amsa, ɗaga kundin adireshi, gyara lissafin izini
settings.capHint: Ba da izini shine abin da ke faɗaɗa iyakar akwatin sandbox, don haka ya bambanta da kawai tuƙi da ke akwai.
settings.regenerateTitle: Yana fitar da sabon alama. An yanke duk wani abu da ke amfani da tsohon.
settings.tokenHint: Canza ko sabunta alamar yana aiki lokacin da kake nema, kuma yana yanke wani abu har yanzu yana amfani da tsohuwar.
settings.uiMissing: Ba a sami ginin gaba ba, don haka sabobin za su amsa API amma ba su da UI da za su yi hidima. Gudu npm run build kuma sake gina ƙa'idar.
tools.tool.jq.label: jq
tools.tool.jq.description: Layin umarni JSON processor, don karantawa da sake fasalin API martani.
tools.tool.ripgrep.label: ripgrep
tools.tool.ripgrep.description: Bincike mai saurin gaske. Abin da wakili ya kai ga maimakon grep -r.
tools.tool.curl.label: dunƙule
tools.tool.curl.description: HTTP abokin ciniki, don neman URL an ba wa wakilin damar isa.
tools.tool.zip.label: zip / cire
tools.tool.htmlq.label: htmlq
tools.tool.htmlq.description: Tambayoyin masu zaɓe na CSS akan HTML, kamar jq don alama. Mai amfani don gogewa.
tools.tool.git.label: Git
tools.tool.git.description: Ikon sigar. Kunna ta tsohuwa saboda akwatin ci gaba ba tare da git ba yana da wahala a yi amfani da shi, amma kayan aiki ne kamar kowane: kashe shi kuma ba binary ko git config.
tools.tool.rea.label: REA (Injiniya ta baya)
tools.tool.rea.description: Binciken injiniya na baya-bayan nan don aikace-aikacen da aka aika da binaries: daure na Electron da JavaScript, .Majalisun NET, Go da Rust binaries, archives da albarkatun PE. Duk bincike yana gudana cikin wannan akwatin yashi.
tools.tool.rea.cost: Yana ƙara kusan 330 MB da minti ɗaya zuwa gini na gaba. Rushewar asali yana buƙatar Ghidra, Hopper ko IDA, waɗanda wannan hoton baya ɗauka.
tools.tool.dejared.label: Dejared (Java decompiler)
tools.tool.dejared.description: Bincika kuma a haɗa Java .jar ma'ajiyar bayanai: jeri fakiti da albarkatu, azuzuwan bincike da kirtani, karanta metadata na aji, kuma a haɗa zuwa Java tare da CFR, Vineflower ko Procyon. Yana gudana a cikin wannan akwatin yashi tare da nasa Java 17 runtime. A Spring Boot fat-jar, WAR, EAR ko AAR yana adana azuzuwan a ƙarƙashin prefix na gida kuma yakamata a fara buɗe kaya.
tools.tool.dejared.cost: Yana ƙara lokacin gudu Java 17 da kusan MB 25 na mai lalata JAR, da minti ɗaya zuwa gini na gaba.
tools.tool.ffdec.label: FFDec (Flash decompiler)
tools.tool.ffdec.description: Bincika, tarawa da faci fayilolin Shockwave Flash (SWF): tags, classes, alamomi, ActionScript, bytecode, akai-akai da halaye, sannan ajiye SWF da aka gyara. An haɗa JPEXS FFDec CLI don fitar da saman MCP ba ya rufe.
tools.tool.ffdec.cost: Yana ƙara lokacin gudu Java 25, uwar garken FFDec MCP da JPEXS FFDec CLI: kusan 230 MB da minti ɗaya zuwa gini na gaba.
tools.tool.mcp-reverse.label: mcp-reverse (benci na RE)
tools.tool.mcp-reverse.description: Benci na aikin injiniyan baya a bayan uwar garken MCP guda ɗaya: masu binciken asali na PE, ELF, Mach-O, DEX, .NET, Unity da Unreal, gwajin entropy da packer, dokokin YARA, rarrabewa da kwaɗaitar x86-64 da ARM64, ɓoye sirrin kirtani, kwatancen ayyuka, da tushen ilimi na ƙwarewa 4,200 mai bincike tare da ragamar wakilai da cibiyar decompiler. Masu binciken asali suna aiki a cikin wannan sandbox; gadojin Ghidra, IDA, Binary Ninja, x64dbg da Frida suna buƙatar waɗannan kayan aikin su kasance suna aiki a na'urar mai aiki, kuma a nan suna bayyana ba su samuwa.
tools.tool.mcp-reverse.cost: Yana ƙara runtime Node 24 da aka liƙa, uwar garken da tushen bayanan ƙwarewarsa na 18 MB: kusan 170 MB, da minti ɗaya ko biyu a ginawa ta gaba.
tools.tool.zero-breach.label: Zero Breach (binciken spyware)
tools.tool.zero-breach.description: Bincike na layi-ɗaya na alamun spyware na haya da aka buga -- Pegasus, Predator, Graphite, Candiru da sauransu. Idan an ba shi damar shiga kwamfuta, yana duba dukan wannan kwamfutar: tarihin burauza, kukis da ajiya, SHA-256 na fayil da hashes ɗin samfurori da aka buga, shigarwar hosts, bayanan DNS da shigarwar farawa; akan waya yana karanta tarin AndroidQF, ajiyar iPhone, tsarin fayil da aka cire ko sysdiagnose, kuma akan babban fayil yana duba waɗannan fayilolin kawai. Abin da ba a iya dubawa yana bayar da shi a matsayin gibi ba a matsayin tsafta ba. Binciken karatu ne kawai, ba ya buƙatar mai gudanarwa kuma ba ya yin buƙatar cibiyar sadarwa; ana sauke jerin alamun lokacin gina wannan image. A cikin wannan sandbox yana iya karanta abin da aka ɗaura kawai, don haka binciken dukan kwamfutar mai aiki ne ke gudanar da shi a wannan kwamfutar. An yi shi da @archive.genocide a Instagram.
tools.tool.zero-breach.cost: Yana ƙara Python 3, wannan kayan aiki da jerin alamun da aka sauke: kusan 50 MB, da minti ɗaya a ginawa ta gaba.
tools.tool.web-search.label: Binciken Yanar Gizo
tools.tool.web-search.description: Binciken gidan yanar gizo na DeepCode. Yana buƙatar API mai siyarwa, don haka shima yana buɗewa API a cikin tace cibiyar sadarwa yayin da yake kunne.
tools.tool.node.label: Node.js
tools.tool.node.description: JavaScript runtime. Tuni a cikin hoton tushe; kunna yana tabbatar da sabon layi.
tools.tool.npm.label: npm
tools.tool.npm.description: Manajan fakitin JavaScript, an sabunta shi zuwa sabon saki.
tools.tool.xvfb.label: Nuni na gani (Xvfb)
tools.tool.xvfb.description: Allon da ke akwai kawai a cikin wannan akwati, don shirye-shiryen da ke son ɗaya. Babu wani abu da ya bayyana akan allon afareta, kuma ana ɗaukar hotunan allo na nunin kanta.
tools.tool.puppeteer.label: Puppeteer
tools.tool.puppeteer.description: Mai bincike da aka sarrafa daga Node, tare da kwafinsa na Chromium. Yana nunawa cikin nunin kama-da-wane lokacin da aka kunna mutum, don haka shafuka suna nuna yadda suke yi ga mutum.
tools.tool.puppeteer.cost: Yana ƙara kusan MB 850 zuwa hoton wannan aikin, da 'yan mintoci kaɗan zuwa ginin na gaba: mai bincike, wanda ba a haɗa shi ba, da dakunan karatu da yake haɗawa da su.
tools.tool.wrangler.label: Wrangler
tools.tool.wrangler.description: Cloudflare's CLI ga Ma'aikata, Shafuna da shagunan KV, R2 da D1.
tools.tool.python.label: Python 3
tools.tool.python.description: Python lokacin gudu tare da pip da tsarin virtualenv.
tools.tool.cargo.label: Tsatsa / cargo
tools.tool.cargo.description: Tsatsa kayan aiki ta hanyar rustup, a cikin gidan mai amfani da akwatin sandbox.
tools.tool.cargo.cost: Mintuna na tattara lokacin farko da aka gina wannan hoton, da sarƙar kayan aiki na Rust.
tools.tool.go.label: Go
tools.tool.go.description: Go Toolchain, an shigar da shi daga wasan ƙwallon ƙafa na hukuma.
tools.tool.apt.label: apt
tools.tool.apt.description: Bari wakili ya shigar da fakitin Debian kanta. Wannan shi ne ainihin manajan fakitin hoton, kuma yana iya shigar da kusan komai, don haka ɗaukar shi a matsayin mafi faɗin waɗannan.
tools.tool.apk.label: apk
tools.tool.brew.label: Homebrew
tools.tool.brew.description: Homebrew akan Linux. Keɓaɓɓen kai a ƙarƙashin gidan mai amfani da akwatin sandbox.
tools.tool.nix.label: Nix
tools.tool.nix.description: Nix tare da flakes. Yana ba da sarƙoƙin kayan aiki na kowane-aiki, akan farashin babban hoto da a hankali ginawa na farko.
docker.detailNotRunning: Docker Desktop baya gudana. Fara shi kuma a sake gwadawa.
docker.detailNoAnswer: Docker Desktop yana gudana, amma daemon sa baya amsawa. Yana iya ɗaukar minti daya don fitowa bayan farawa; idan ta kasance haka, sake farawa Docker Desktop.
docker.detailDesktopLimited: An gano Docker Desktop: daemon yana gudana a cikin VM, don haka akwai iyakantattun zaɓuɓɓukan tauraro.
settings.apiKeyHint: Ajiye a cikin maɓallan tsarin aiki, ba a taɓa cikin fayil ɗin jihar Deepsand ba. Tagan kawai yana nuna haruffa huɗu na ƙarshe. Yana aiki na gaba lokacin da akwatin yashi ya fara.
